name: himalaya
description: 管理邮件。scripts/launch.py 把参数原样传给用户已安装的 Himalaya；未配置时不启动。本包不含程序，不创建账户，也不代发邮件。

himalaya_bin.title: HIMALAYA_BIN
himalaya_bin.description: Required path to the user-installed himalaya native executable. On Windows this must be a .exe, not a .bat or .cmd. No default. Unset disables this entry. This package does not download Himalaya, create an account, or send mail.
